position: Every fixture in this directory describes a comparator that does not run, against an API that does not exist, over an audit store nobody has created. These cases keep that true: the authority constant is imported rather than restated, the design modules are unreachable from the runtime tree, the lane vocabulary refuses any mode where a reader has already moved, and no route, credential, auth check or audit table has appeared anywhere.

authority.why: `prefer` and `only` are modes in which a reader has already moved; `off` is not a comparison at all. The comparator refuses all three rather than producing evidence that describes a lane it is not in.

forbidden_in_runtime_trees.why: A canonical operator read route is the one thing Phase 6 must not grow by accident. The check is over string literals in the trees that run, not over prose in a design document.

no_auth_enforcement.why: These fixtures pin a contract; they do not authorise, authenticate or enforce anything. A comparator with a credential of its own is a reader.

no_live_read_path.why: P6-R5: the node HTTP client is single-threaded and shared, so a comparator that polled a node would be a competing fetcher against live capture. The rule is asserted over imports and string literals so the modules may still explain in prose that they open no socket.
